Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 92.43 is moderate. SOFR is secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.459 is the latest weekly observation for Oct 30, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Board's November calendar lists H.15 at 4:15 PM and H.4.1 at 4:30 PM today. Its Veterans Day notice moves statistical releases scheduled for Nov 11 to Nov 12; no exchange hours or closure is inferred.
  • FOMC minutes for the Oct 27-28 meeting release Nov 18 at 2:00 PM. Next scheduled policy decision and press conference are Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and 2:30 PM ET. New York Fed's December calendar lists Employment Situation Dec 4, CPI Dec 10 and PPI Dec 15 at 8:30 AM ET; CPI and PPI are distinct releases.
  • SOFR 3.88% effective Nov 9, NFCI -0.459 for week ending Oct 30, MOVE 92.43 on Nov 10, and official 10-year Treasury close 4.98% Nov 10. SOFR and NFCI are lagged, not live funding measures.
  • EIA confirms the Veterans Day exception moves the petroleum report to today at noon and natural-gas storage to Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM. TreasuryDirect lists 4- and 8-week bills at 11:30 AM and 17-week bills plus a 30-year bond at 1:00 PM today.
Omissions and Watch
  • Conflict check: New York Fed, NAR and Census schedules support Nov 12 existing-home sales, October retail sales Nov 17 and October residential construction Nov 18. NAR confirms October pending sales Nov 18. New York Fed and BEA agree on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM for Q3 GDP second estimate and October personal income/outlays; periods are sourced from BEA/Census where available.
  • BLS dates/times use the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar; bls.gov was not requested. Periods are included only when stated in checked sources. Coverage is selected, not exhaustive; routine Fed statistical releases beyond H.15/H.4.1 and other agency series are omitted.
  • Chicago Fed release calendar lists CFNAI for Nov 23 but the returned entry gives no release time, so it is omitted from timed rows. No verified week-ahead Philadelphia Fed survey row is included. No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run; this is not a full headline-risk review. No CME contract-hours or settlement details were verified.
  • Classifier unmatched rows (Initial Claims, Weekly Economic Index, SCE Credit Access Survey, Imports and Exports, Industrial Production) remain provisional Medium and are flagged. No overrides; self-test passed. Omitted or unscheduled events are not asserted absent.
  • Primary sources checked: New York Fed November/December calendars, SOFR API and Empire State Survey; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; BEA, Census, NAR, Chicago Fed NFCI and release calendar, TreasuryDirect, U.S. Treasury and EIA schedules. Snapshot: single-source Yahoo chart data; observation times and prior bars stated above.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
ES is 0.42% below Wednesday's completed daily bar overnight, while SPY's Wednesday close gained 1.32%; the overnight pullback is provisional, not a confirmed cash-session reversal. VIX fell to 17.49, MOVE remains moderate at 92.43, and the 10-year yield rose 10 bp to 4.98%. With claims, EIA data, Treasury auctions and selected Fed releases ahead, expect event-sensitive two-way risk; monitor rates, breadth and depth rather than extrapolating a thin overnight move. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if rates or upcoming PPI/retail data materially reprice policy expectations, volatility expands against the overnight move, or ES moves without confirmation from breadth, rates or depth. No unsupported levels or targets supplied. Verify fresh quotes, event notices and intended contract specifications before execution.
